sample_accounting.response_curve_purpose: Multi-lag empirical price response function R(l) across lags l in [1, 100]
sample_accounting.impact_model_purpose: Econometric estimation of structural impact models, HAC inference, Block Bootstrap & Walk-Forward CV
sample_accounting.window_difference_explanation: The 250,000 impact model trades are a strict temporal sub-window of the 300,000 response window (both starting at the session active offset index). The 250,000 size is chosen to keep Newey-West HAC covariance matrix calculation and Moving Block Bootstrap (100 iterations x 4 block lengths) computationally tractable while ensuring statistical power.
sample_accounting.horizon_loss_explanation: At lag k, forward return requires price at i+k; the final k trades cannot form forward returns.
sample_accounting.regression_stride_explanation: Systematic sub-sampling applied when positive trades > 50,000 to enable Newey-West HAC matrix inversion.

sample_metadata.scope_limitation_disclosure: Analyzed sample covers consecutive chronological window from 2026-07-03T05:37:15.255456Z to 2026-07-03T08:30:15.594872Z (10380.3s, 249,995 tick executions). Microstructure empirical parameters (scaling exponent, autocorrelation, point-mass proportions) reflect this specific intraday regime and cannot be extrapolated to full 24-hour trading without cross-regime validation.

wls_fit.name: Weighted Least Squares (weighted by tier sample count)
wls_fit.se_type: Classical WLS SE (unadjusted for cross-tier residual autocorrelation)

trade_level_fit.name: Trade-Level Log-Log HAC (Positive Response Sub-Sample: R > 0)
trade_level_fit.conditioning: Strictly conditional on positive signed price displacement (R_i > 0)
trade_level_fit.caveat: Evaluated on 88,454 systematically sampled trades (stride=1 from 88,454 positive price displacement trades, 35.4% of sample); cannot serve as an unconditional full-sample validation because zero and adverse price moves (161,541 trades, 64.6% of sample) are dropped by the log transform.

out_of_sample_validation.description: 50% chronological split with purged transition buffer
out_of_sample_validation.purging_rationale: Purged 5 boundary trades to eliminate lookahead return leakage across horizon k=5
out_of_sample_validation.note: Evaluates training-fitted parameters on held-out test data. Power-law and logarithmic parameters are strictly fitted on the training split prior to lookahead purge buffer.

moving_block_bootstrap.methodology: Moving Block Bootstrap with economic tier re-stratification
moving_block_bootstrap.sensitivity_summary: Statistical inference conclusions flip across temporal block lengths (OLS H0: gamma = 0 (zero containment)). Empirical conclusions depend substantially on the temporal block dependence specification and cannot be asserted as unconditionally invariant.

hypothesis_test_sqrt_law.null_hypothesis: H0: gamma = 0.5 (Square-Root Law for Child Trades)
hypothesis_test_sqrt_law.interpretation: Square-root price impact is an empirical scaling relationship. This study estimates the power-law exponent under specified assets, intraday sample intervals, and regression specifications to evaluate compatibility with gamma = 0.5 (WLS gamma = -0.1210, 95% WLS CI: [-0.2052, -0.0367], is strictly negative (excludes zero)) rejects compatibility with square-root exponent gamma = 0.5 (t = -14.45, p = 0.0000e+00); OLS gamma = -0.0329, 95% OLS CI: [-0.1323, 0.0664], encompasses zero) rejects H0: gamma = 0.5 (t = -10.51, p = 0.0000e+00). Results do not demonstrate universal or cross-asset validity. Child-order tick response cannot be conflated with exogenous meta-order impact or guaranteed execution alpha. Models exhibit low in-sample and out-of-sample explanatory power.
